task_prompt.title: fix structure for union of attr classes with default values
task_prompt.description:
Structure union of attr classes when one of the fields was optional and had a default value was not deterministic.

Disambiguator function sometimes was created to use field with default value - and because it's allowed to not provide this value to `__init__` method wrong class was chosen to structure.

A provided test case is a minimal deterministic test I was able to generate.

task_prompt.title: fix MultiStrategyDispatch to work with new GenConverter and attrs inheritance
task_prompt.description:
Because the GenConverter specifically handles generating code for
attrs classes, and because it registers hooks that don't require
function dispatch, singledispatch was preventing subclasses from
having code generated for them, because they would trigger the
previously-generated base class's structure/unstructure code.

This changes MultiStrategyDispatch to allow for a class-based hook to
specifically avoid single-dispatch. Since we know that a given attrs
class can always have code generated for it, we don't really want to
share dispatch across subclasses - like the original Converter, we
want to make sure we're structuring each individual attrs class as its
own separate type.

fixes #116

task_prompt.title: Forbid extra fields when structuring dictionaries into attrs classes
task_prompt.description: Would resolve #101.  I'm assuming this will need some further work (e.g. new tests; fixing other tests this breaks, etc), but wanted to go ahead and get it up for a first review to see if the approach is reasonable.
